title: Compact learner lane: condensed onboarding checklist and product tour cards
creator: Priya Shah
description: Design a compact, card-based onboarding lane ("learner lane") to replace the current multi-panel tour. Cards are condensed, stackable, and intended for first-run and empty-state contexts. The lane must: 1) surface 3–5 progressive checklist items; 2) support microtips and inline screenshots; 3) collapse into a single badge after completion; 4) work in widths from 360px (mobile) to 1440px (desktop). This ticket covers visual design, copy variants, asset exports, and a lightweight implementation spec for engineering handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Three responsive card variants (compact, expanded, collapsed) created in Figma
Copy variants for progressive display and completed state (EN + two tone-of-voice variants)
PNG/SVG exports for all icons and hero thumbnails at 1x and 2x
Annotated spec with spacing tokens, color tokens, and accessible contrast levels
QA checklist for animation timing and keyboard navigation provided
Design review approval from PM and accessibility lead
review_notes: 2026-03-11 - PM (Mateo Rossi): prefer 4 items max to avoid cognitive load; ok with collapse badge behavior
2026-03-11 - Eng (Nina Lopez): confirmed that card state can be persisted via localStorage + server flag; requested exact class names for focus states
2026-03-12 - Accessibility (Claire Johnson): suggested increasing CTA contrast to meet AA for normal text; requested aria-live region for dynamic tip updates
decisions: Use card carousel on narrow viewports and inline stack on wide viewports
Persist completed checklist on a per-user flag in the console profile and fallback to client-side persistence for unauthed sessions
Animations limited to opacity/translate Y to avoid layout jank; 180ms enter, 120ms exit
dev_handoff: tokens: spacing-xs/8, spacing-sm/12, spacing-md/16; color-primary/blue-600; surface/neutral-0
spec: keyboard focus order, enter/space to expand card, ESC to collapse, tab focus trap disabled
